speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What stuff is He?
premises: Fire, moon, sun, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, still, moving — His very stuff.
To the many-shaped, to knowing-shaped Thee — bow.
inference: All stuff is His stuff; the many-shaped is knowing-shaped.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What burns?
premises: Great fire, universe for fuel, bright with pure ash-smeared.
To Thee, the Becoming, whose one offering is the world — bow.
inference: The world fuels His fire; His fire's oblation is the world.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What cools?
premises: Śiva-fire cool, thick with highest nectar.
To some Unequalled, all-devouring when the world burns — homage.
inference: Cool nectar-fire and world-burning Unequalled: both addressed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: By what names?
premises: Mahādeva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Śiva — Great-Lord Thee — bow.
And to some mantra-bodied one — bow.
inference: Name-catalogue bowed; mantra-bodied kept indefinite (kasmai cid).

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What unction?
premises: Śiva-fire: cut, sucked dry, three worlds' melted fat His unction.
Unequalled yet kind.
inference: Dread fuel, kind flame: the offering is the burnt world.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What marks Him?
premises: Whose mark is this alone — that no marks meet.
To God, to gracious some Śambhu — homage.
inference: Marklessness marked: His sign is no-sign.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What of Veda and Āgama?
premises: Against Veda and Āgama, maker of Veda and Āgama, their true essence.
To the hidden Master — bow.
inference: Veda-foe and Veda-maker at once; hidden mastery bowed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What of the round?
premises: Sole maker of the world-round, sole unmaker.
Round-shaped, round-free — gracious Śambhu, bow.
inference: Cause and foe of saṃsāra in one breath.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What of root, middle, tip?
premises: Root, middle, tip; shaped as all three; tip-middle-root outworn.
To the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
inference: Triad stated and outworn; Fullness bowed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What of the Name?
premises: Bow: Name-taking even once IS merit-heaps ripened.
To hard-to-win Śiva Thee.
inference: One utterance ripens merit-heaps; difficulty bowed with ease.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What play?
premises: Amid heaped moving-unmoving crowds, ever playing for Thee, the One.
Knowing-shaped, skull-wearing.
inference: Crowd-play for the One; skull-wearing knowing bowed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What contrarieties?
premises: Trickster, pure; hidden, self-shown; fine, all-shaped — bow.
To wonder-variegated Śambhu.
inference: Contraries catalogued; wonder held double (citra).
uncertainties: citra holds wonder and variegated at once; kept double.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: Whose sport unmakes?
premises: All-might, whose sport unmakes Brahmā-Indra-Viṣṇu-arrayed world.
Wonder to be worked — bow.
inference: Gods' array unmade in sport; wonder bowed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: Who wins powers?
premises: Powers won by shore-roamers only — roamers of His shores.
Bow to fathomless Hara-sea.
inference: Only shore-roamers win; fathomlessness bowed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What lotus?
premises: Mud-dwelling in Māyā-thick world — unsmeared.
Bow to shining hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus.
inference: Mud-seated, unsmeared: lotus bowed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What sequence?
premises: Kind, pure; treasure; self-adorned; dear; last-real; highest.
To Thee — bow.
inference: Attribute-ladder climbed to the highest.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: Bound or free?
premises: Ever-bound, ever sharing freedom; lacking bond and freedom both.
To some Śambhu even — bow.
inference: Bondage and freedom both held and dropped.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What of the jeering world?
premises: Three-world all, whose stuff is jeering.
To Thee alone, secondless, ever bliss-throned — bow.
inference: Jeering world set against bliss-throned Secondless.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What rites?
premises: Right-rite's heart, left-rite's lover; all-rite, Śarva, rite-free.
To Thee — bow.
inference: Every rite-stance taken and transcended.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: Which god?
premises: Be it how it may — whoever worshipped, wherever honored, whichever god.
To him homage: to Thee.
inference: All worship lands on Thee, whoever named.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What giving?
premises: Release-hungers served; thief of every fever; loveliness at choicest.
Boon-giver — bow.
inference: Fever-thief, boon-giver bowed.
uncertainties: vara puns choicest and boon-giver; hārin kept as thief.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What feast?
premises: Always three worlds brimmed with unbroken bliss-sap.
Bow, Master of the never-ending feast.
inference: Unbroken bliss; endless feast mastered.
uncertainties: parvan kept as feast-day: festival as ontology.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What of His powers?
premises: Whatever courts Thee indeed, through pleasure-first tastes, enjoying.
To that dread power-ring of Thine — homage.
inference: The verse turns: from Him to His dread ring.
uncertainties: bhaj kept as court: powers court Him, we bow to them.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: Who holds Him?
premises: Past even sages' knowing.
Yet love-yoked gesture-holders hold Him fast. To some Becoming — bow.
inference: Turn: from knowing to embracing; sages outpaced, lovers holding.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What nectar?
premises: Highest-nectar's sheath, highest-nectar's heap.
Reached past beyond and no-beyond — to Becoming — bow.
inference: Nectar-caskets past every beyond bowed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What form praised?
premises: Mantra through and through — I praise Thy form.
Clear, cool, lovely with unheard joy, lush with highest-nectar sap.
inference: Mantra-made form praised in sense-detail.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What teaching?
premises: On oneness-fame's wide canvas, freedom-nectar-grounded.
Where wonder isn't — that I praise: Thy teaching.
inference: Teaching praised where wonder ends.
uncertainties: paṭa read as painter's canvas; pūrṇatvāt as its ground.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What road?
premises: Thunderbolt to doubts, doomsday-fire to ill-lucks, aeon-end to joylessness.
We bow the Great-Lord road.
inference: Triple thunder bowed as road.
uncertainties: Lakshmanjoo: alakṣmī as ill-luck/poverty; numaḥ kept plural — our bowing is the path.

speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
question: What shelter?
premises: Hail God! Bow on bow; all world leans on Thee.
Worlds' high Lord, One supreme — I am come for shelter.
inference: Close: from victory-cries to refuge-taken.
